title: Ask AI for help
caption: Stuck? Ask the AI before you ask me: it is quicker, and the move works with every tool.
statement: When you are stuck, paste what you see into an AI, say where you are, and ask for one next step.

stuck.label: Stuck
stuck.text: An error, an odd answer, a button you can’t find.

help.label: Help
help.text: Paste what you see into the box under Help on any hands-on Slide.

copy.label: Copy prompt
copy.text: It adds where you are and asks for plain words.

next.label: One next step
next.text: Paste it into an AI chat, try what it says.

tryIt: Try it now: Help sits at the top right of this Slide.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

chats.openAIChatTip: Open an empty {chat} chat in a new tab, then paste the prompt

help.step: Learning to ask AI for help, before the hands-on starts

talking-points.header: Sell the move, not the button
talking-points.description: Asking AI to explain where you are stuck is a skill for every tool, not only today’s. The Help box only writes the prompt: where you are, what you see, plain words, one next step. Have everyone open Help once now, so they find it later.
